text:
Priya: Heads-up — bringing up Llama-3-pruned on our quant infra. Quick eval shows token-level aliasing when we use the 'unified-vocab' converter. Example: prompt with long context suddenly repeats last 8 tokens.
Sam: Can you paste the token diff? sounds like token id remap, maybe offsets.
Priya: log snippet: `orig_ids: [50256, 27, 431, 84] -> mapped_ids: [259, 27, 431, 84]`. Repro: ./tools/token-id-diff.py --orig tokenizers/llama.json --new converters/unified.json --sample "The quick brown fox jumps". Got ~3.4% mismatches on common tokens.
Marta: hmm could be converter dropping special tokens or reassigning emoji slots. Rotary phase shouldn't care about token ids, but if BOS/offset changes then positions shift and KV cache alignment breaks. :thinking_face:
Sam: rotary uses position params, correct. But the live symptom (repeating tail) smells like a 1-token shift in KV cache. Check for extra/missing BOS/EOS or different vocab size (packers sometimes assume multiple of 8/16).
Priya: vsize diff: orig=50257, unified=50256 (unified dropped <unk>). Converter mapping file shows some punctuation moved. I attach attention debug dump:
```
KVcache[0] ids: 50256 27 431 84 992
KVcache[1] ids: 27 431 84 992 33
# observed shift of +1 in later layers
```
Marta: I'll implement a remapper that re-pins special tokens and outputs a mapping table. Plan: run remap -> replay KV cache -> compare logits and greedy decodes. ETA ~2h. @Priya can you drop the failing sample set into /scratch/token-remap/?

Sam: also add quant packer sanity (vocab size mod alignment) and a small KV-replay test for 8k prefix. +1 from me.
Marta: ack. I'll push remap script and add step to model-onboarding/evals. Will post PR link when ready.
